t: You're on Holles Street, in Marylebone, which runs from the south side of Cavendish Square down to Oxford Street. The street takes its name from John Holles, the first Duke of Newcastle. He was an English peer and politician, made Duke in 1694 in recognition of his loyalty to the Williamite regime. He later served as Lord Privy Seal. So the name here goes back to a duke who was rewarded for his political loyalty.
